reason: The source and existing tests define a narrow backend fix. No checks were executed. One baseline and one minimal fix suffice; five candidates and literature comparison would not help evaluate this defect.
goal: Accept surrounding whitespace when parsing true/false, preserve ValueError for other strings, change only parser.py, and verify through existing unittest and independent review.

criteria.title: Parse whitespace-surrounded boolean strings
criteria.acceptance: Before modification, the existing suite reproduces the whitespace failure. After modification, ParseTests.test_whitespace passes: " True " returns True and "\tFALSE\n" returns False. Preserve both execution receipts.

criteria.title: Reject strings outside normalized true/false
criteria.acceptance: ParseTests.test_invalid passes before and after modification. Independent source inspection confirms that only values equal to true or false after surrounding-whitespace removal and case normalization return booleans; all other strings raise ValueError.

criteria.title: Keep the implementation change minimal
criteria.acceptance: The final diff changes only parser.py, adds surrounding-whitespace normalization, and preserves the function signature, case-insensitive comparisons, boolean results, and ValueError behavior.

criteria.title: Independently verify the final fix
criteria.acceptance: An independent reviewer inspects the final parser.py, unchanged tests, actual diff, and baseline/post-change unittest receipts, recording unresolved defects or evidence gaps explicitly.

complexity_baseline: One normalization expression, two comparisons, and a ValueError fallback. Retain this structure without dependencies or additional parsing branches.
